title: Estimation and Inference for Synthetic Control Methods with Spillover Effects
abstract: arXiv:1902.07343v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Estimation and inference procedures for synthetic control methods often do not allow for the existence of spillover effects, which are plausible in many applications. In this paper, we consider estimation and inference for synthetic control methods, allowing for spillover effects. We propose estimators for both direct treatment effects and spillover effects and show that they are asymptotically unbiased. In addition, we propose an asymptotically valid inference procedure. Our estimation and inference procedure applies to cases with multiple treated units and/or multiple post-treatment periods, and to ones where the underlying factor model is either stationary or cointegrated. We discuss the bias from misspecified spillover structures and propose a test for correct specification. Simulation shows that our method beats existing methods when the remaining pure donor is substantially different from the treated unit. We apply our method t

translated_title: 具有溢出效应的合成控制方法的估计与推断
translated_abstract: 合成控制方法的估计与推断程序通常不允许存在溢出效应，而溢出效应在许多实际应用中是可能出现的。本文在允许溢出效应存在的条件下，研究了合成控制方法的估计与推断问题。我们提出了直接处理效应和溢出效应的估计量，并证明它们是渐近无偏的。此外，我们提出了一种渐近有效的推断程序。我们的估计和推断程序适用于存在多个处理单元和/或多个处理后期数的情形，也适用于潜在因子模型为平稳或协整的情形。我们讨论了溢出结构设定错误所带来的偏差，并提出了一个用于检验溢出结构正确设定的检验方法。模拟结果表明，当剩余的纯供体单元与处理单元存在显著差异时，我们的方法优于现有方法。我们将该方法应用于……
tldr: 本文提出了允许溢出效应存在的合成控制方法估计与推断程序，证明了估计量的渐近无偏性，并适用于多处理单元、多处理后期数以及平稳或协整因子模型等更一般的情形。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes estimation and inference procedures for synthetic control methods that allow for spillover effects, establishing asymptotic unbiasedness of the estimators and applicability to multiple treated units, multiple post-treatment periods, and stationary or cointegrated factor models.
